title: Pydantic AI: Basic Request
description: Minimal agent with instructions only: run_sync sends the prompt, show_context displays what the model received.

steps.description: Complete basic agent example: import, agent creation, invoke, print, and context display.
Imports: pydantic_ai Agent, and common helpers make_model, show_context, watch.
Agent creation: Agent with make_model, instructions as concise study-planning assistant, capabilities with watch.
Execution: run_sync with the question, print output, then show_context to reveal the window.
